An RF generator with a sweep function is also desirable, although a generator without the sweep function is acceptable.

For the most part, the technician will be verifying the existance and value of different oscillations within the system. Since the majority of SSB generated signals are of the balanced modulator type, most SSB systems are closely identical.

This knowledge does not preclude the necessity to identify the generation method used from one system to the next. In the absence of a technical manual for a given piece of equipment, a schematic analysis of the system must be performed.

Prior to troubleshooting, an assessment of the equipment's operational status should be made. The checklist below is a guideline to assist you to that end. O

1. The SSB Card set has no visual indicators. However, if audio can be heard coming from the speaker, then the system's power supply is functioning correctly. In fact, if there is an audible tone from either the on-board signal generator or from an external unit, then 90% of the system may be ruled functional.

2. On the PC130-450 Card; with input selector, S2, in the function generator position, exercise S3 while listening for a change in tone. There should be two distinct tones, one at 400 Hz and one at 1 kHz.
3. Switch S2 to the microphone position. Now exercise the microphone with either voice or a whistle. The sound should be reproduced on the 130 Test Console.

4. Return switch S2 to the function generator position. On PC130-452 card, place S1 to the opposite sideband from its present setting. Do the same to S1 on PC130-453. An undistorted tone should still be heard.
5. Because you were able to adjust the volume, the audio section of the system is functioning.
6. On PC130-450, place switch S3 to the EXT (External) position. The tone should not be heard unless TP1, the External Input, is connected to a signal generator.
This checklist has allowed you to verify the serviceability of the SSB system's functions. In a commercial receiver or transceiver, a much more involved checklist would have to be developed.
